Definition: to be transparent or clean (phys. or morally)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be pure, be bright, be clean, be bright, clean; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be bright, be shining; 1a2) to be clean, be pure; 1b) (Hiphil) to cleanse, make cleanse, make clean
